text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My birthday party, is it? Yes. I would 
gladly love to attend.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ayyy! I came up with a totally hype event, 
so get hyped, 'kay~?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I came up with a project too! My 
indie film, "The Unsinkable Kickoff☆"! A 
side-splitting detective drama that's 
guaranteed to make you laugh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm doing Flash-san's makeup! We're gonna 
go full gyaru and take a ton of purikura 
âª

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
We're doing a comedy contest too! Make me 
laugh and I'll give ya a gyotaku print of 
a jellyfish!!

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I am truly delighted by such an enticing 
event. However, if we take our time 
enjoying each one, we'll likely miss 
curfew."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Huh? I didn't think that far ahead. Hmm... 
seems a bit tough, maybe?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"...No. We can carry it out by dividing 
the event into passive and active 
segments."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Jordan-san, if it's not too much trouble, 
please hang a smartphone around your neck 
and play a movie during makeup. This is so 
I can focus on watching it while having my 
makeup applied.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
The comedy prompt challenge will take 
place while taking purikura photos. I want 
to make sure I hear the prompt clearly, so 
please permit me to wear headphones.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ah, of course, I won't forget to smile 
either.
